parts.q:
Teacher: What do you think about mobile phones in class?
Laylo: In my ______, they should be switched off.
parts.explain: «In my opinion, ...» — «Mening fikrimcha». Belgilangan ibora, faqat «opinion» so'zi bilan.

wrong.idea: «In my idea» degan ibora ingliz tilida yo'q.
wrong.mind: «In my mind» — «xayolimda», fikr bildirish iborasi emas.

parts.q:
Ali: Do you think the new park is nice?
Sardor: To be ______, I don't like it very much.
parts.explain: «To be honest, ...» — «Rostini aytsam». Ochiq fikr oldidan, ayniqsa yoqmasa.

wrong.true: «To be true» deyilmaydi; «It's true that ...» boshqa ibora.
wrong.real: «To be real» rasmiy ingliz tilida ishlatilmaydi.

parts.q:
Madina: Is the city centre safe at night?
Kamola: It ______ to me that it's quite safe now.
parts.explain: «It seems to me that ...» — «Menga shunday tuyuladiki». «seem to me» bilan keladi.

wrong.looks: «It looks to me» — rasmda ko'rinishni tasvirlashda, fikr iborasi emas.

parts.q:
Jasur: Why are young people so tired?
Nodir: As I ______ it, they go to bed too late.
parts.explain: «As I see it, ...» — «Men qanday ko'rsam». Fiksirlangan ibora, faqat «see».

parts.q:
Zarina: How did people travel 200 years ago?
Dilnoza: I ______ that it was very slow and uncomfortable.
parts.explain: «I imagine that ...» — «Tasavvurimcha». Aniq bilmagan narsani taxmin qilganda.

wrong.agree: «I agree» — birovga qo'shilish; bu yerda hech kim fikr aytmadi.
wrong.seem: «I seem that» — grammatik xato; to'g'risi «It seems to me that».

parts.q:
Otabek: Will it be easy to find a job?
Aziz: I don't ______ that it will be easy. There aren't many jobs.
parts.explain: «I don't think that ...» — «Menimcha ... emas». Inkor «think»ga qo'yiladi.

wrong.agree: «I don't agree that» — birovning fikriga qarshi chiqish; bu yerda savolga o'z fikr aytilyapti.
wrong.say: «I don't say that» — «buni aytmayman», fikr iborasi emas.

parts.q:
Malika: Can money make people happy?
Shahzoda: I ______ that money can't buy happiness.
parts.explain: «I believe that ...» — «...ga ishonaman». Qattiq ishongan fikr.

parts.q:
Emma: I think homework is useful.
You: I agree ______ Emma that homework helps us remember.
parts.explain: Odamga qo'shilganda — «agree with + odam».

wrong.on: «agree on» — biror narsa bo'yicha kelishish, odamdan oldin emas.

parts.q:
Tom: Cycling to school is dangerous.
You: Tom is ______ to say that, because there are a lot of cars.
parts.phrase: (Tom) is right / wrong to say that ... because ...
parts.explain: «(Tom) is right to say that ... because ...» — «Tom ... deb to'g'ri aytyapti, chunki ...».

parts.q:
Tom: Video games are a waste of time.
You: I think Tom is ______ to say that, because some games teach you things.
parts.phrase: (Tom) is right / wrong to say that ... because ...
parts.explain: Qo'shilmasak — «is wrong to say that». Keyingi «because some games teach» qarshi fikrni ko'rsatadi.

wrong.bad: «is bad to say» — iboraga to'g'ri kelmaydi.

parts.q:
Sam: Fast food is cheap.
You: It's ______ that it's cheap, but it isn't healthy.
parts.explain: «It's true that ..., but ...» — qisman qo'shilish: «To'g'ri, ..., lekin ...».

wrong.right: «It's right that» — «adolatli» ma'nosiga yaqin, qisman qo'shilish iborasi «It's true that».
wrong.real: «It's real that» — ingliz tilida bunday ibora yo'q.

parts.q:
Teacher: Compare the two photos, please.
Anvar: The common ______ in the photos is sport.
parts.phrase: The common theme in the photos is ...
parts.explain: «The common theme in the photos is ...» — «Rasmlardagi umumiy mavzu — ...».

wrong.thing: «common thing» — tushunarli, lekin bu Functions Bank iborasi emas va rasmiy emas.
wrong.topic of: «common topic of in the photos» — grammatik xato.

parts.q:
Examiner: What can you see?
Lola: ______ photos show people working outside.
parts.explain: Ikki rasm haqida — «Both photos show ...».

wrong.All: «All» — uch yoki undan ko'p narsa uchun.
wrong.Two: «Two photos show» — ma'nosi tushunarli, ammo o'xshashlikni bildiradigan ibora «Both».

parts.q:
Examiner: Is there anything the same?
Sanjar: Yes, in both photos ______ are children.
parts.explain: «In both photos there are + ko'plik» — «Ikkala rasmda ham ... bor».

parts.q:
Examiner: How are the photos different?
Mohira: The first photo shows a beach, ______ the second photo shows mountains.
parts.phrase: The first photo shows ..., whereas the second photo shows ...
parts.explain: «whereas» — «...esa». Ikki gapni qarama-qarshi qilib bog'laydi.

wrong.unlike: «unlike» dan keyin ot keladi, gap emas (Unlike the first photo, ...).

parts.q:
Examiner: Any differences?
Timur: One obvious ______ is that the first photo is in winter.
parts.explain: «One obvious difference is (that) ...» — ot kerak: «difference».

parts.q:
Examiner: Now the second photo.
Shoira: ______ the first photo, the second photo shows a very busy street.
parts.phrase: Unlike the first photo, the second photo shows ...
parts.explain: «Unlike + ot, ...» — «...dan farqli ravishda». Gap boshida, keyin vergul.

wrong.Whereas: «whereas» ikki gap o'rtasida keladi va undan keyin ot emas, gap kerak.
wrong.Both: «Both the first photo» — ma'nosiz, o'xshashlik so'zi.

parts.q:
Emma: Learning a second language is easy for children.
You: I ______ with Emma that children learn languages quickly.
parts.explain: «I agree with + odam + that ...» — birovning fikriga qo'shilish.

parts.q:
Tom: Public transport is too expensive.
You: I think Tom is right ______ say that, because tickets cost a lot.
parts.phrase: (Tom) is right / wrong to say that ... because ...
parts.explain: «is right to say that» — «to» + fe'l.

parts.q:
Examiner: How are the photos different?
Aziza: ______ the first photo, the second photo shows people indoors.
parts.phrase: Unlike the first photo, the second photo shows ...
parts.explain: Farq — «Unlike the first photo, ...».

parts.q: Look at these picture options for our school project. ______ my opinion, the first one is much more interesting for teenagers.
parts.explain: Bu yerda «In my opinion,» (Mening fikrimcha) iborasi ishlatilgan.

wrong.On: «On my opinion» deyilmaydi, to'g'ri ko'rinishi «In my opinion».
wrong.At: «At my opinion» grammatik jihatdan noto'g'ri ibora.

parts.q: Look at the student in the picture. It ______ to me that he is preparing for his exams in Tashkent.
parts.explain: «It seems to me that...» (Menga shunday tuyuladiki...) iborasida «seems» fe'li ishlatiladi.

wrong.looks: «It looks to me» bu yerda standart ibora o'rniga mos kelmaydi.
wrong.feels: «It feels to me» bu fikr bildirish iborasida qo'llanilmaydi.

parts.q: We need to choose a holiday destination. To ______ honest, I prefer going to Samarkand rather than staying at home.
parts.explain: «To be honest,» (Rostini aytsam) iborasida «be» fe'li keladi.

wrong.make: «To make honest» iborasi ingliz tilida mavjud emas.
wrong.get: «To get honest» bu kontekstda noto'g'ri ishlatilgan.

parts.q: Both pictures show teenagers working hard. As I ______ it, spending time on study is very important.
parts.explain: «As I see it,» (Mening qarashimcha) iborasida «see» fe'li ishlatiladi.

wrong.watch: «As I watch it» iborasi bu ma'noni bermaydi.
wrong.look: «As I look it» grammatik xato hisoblanadi.

parts.q: Look at the people in the second photo. I ______ that they are having a great time at the birthday party.
parts.explain: «I imagine that...» (Tassavur qilishimcha / O'ylashimcha...) iborasi taxmin bildiradi.

wrong.know: Fotosuratga qarab aniq bilib bo'lmaydi, faqat taxmin qilinadi.
wrong.wonder: «I wonder that» o'rniga taxmin uchun «imagine» mos keladi.

parts.q: I ______ think that doing homework on Sunday is a good idea. We need rest.
parts.explain: Fikrni inkor qilishda «I don't think that...» (Men shunday deb o'ylamayman) iborasi ishlatiladi.

wrong.aren't: «I aren't think» shaxs va zamonga mos kelmaydi.

parts.q: I ______ that teenagers should help their parents around the house every weekend.
parts.explain: Fikr bildirish uchun «I believe that...» (Men ishonamanki...) iborasi qo'llaniladi.

wrong.hope: Umumiy fikr-qarash bildirish uchun «believe» ko'proq mos.
wrong.desire: «I desire that» iborasi bu kontekstga mos tushmaydi.

parts.q: Anvar says online learning is convenient. I agree ______ Anvar that it saves a lot of time.
parts.explain: Biror kishining fikriga qo'shilishda «agree with (someone)» ishlatiladi.

wrong.to: «Agree to» taklifga rozi bo'lishda ishlatiladi, shaxs bilan emas.

parts.q: Lola is ______ to say that learning foreign languages is useful because it opens up career opportunities.
parts.phrase: (Tom) is right / wrong to say that ... because ...
parts.explain: «(Someone) is right to say that...» (Kimdir buni aytib haq) iborasi ishlatiladi.

wrong.correctly: «is» fe'lidan so'ng ravish («correctly») emas, sifat keladi.
wrong.true: Kishi haqida gapirganda «is true» emas, «is right» deyiladi.

parts.q: It's ______ that living in a big city like Tashkent is quite exciting for teenagers.
parts.explain: «It's true that...» (Haqiqatan ham...) iborasida «true» sifati qo'llaniladi.

wrong.right: «It's right that» bu yerda holat haqiqatligini bildirish uchun ishlatilmaydi.
wrong.sure: «It's sure that» bu konstruktsiyada mos kelmaydi.

parts.q: The common ______ in the photos is outdoor summer activities with family.
parts.phrase: The common theme in the photos is ...
parts.explain: Rasm taqqoslashda umumiy mavzuni ko'rsatuvchi «The common theme in the photos is...» iborasi qo'llaniladi.

wrong.topic: Rasmlarni taqqoslash standart iborasida «theme» so'zi ishlatiladi.
wrong.subject: «Common subject» bu funktsional iborada qo'llanilmaydi.

parts.q: You can see a group of happy teenagers ______ both photos.
parts.phrase: You can see ... in both photos.
parts.explain: «in both photos» (har ikkala suratda) iborasida «in» predlogi ishlatiladi.

wrong.on: Surat ichidagi narsalar haqida gapirganda «in photo» deyiladi.

parts.q: Essay: Many people say that cities are dangerous. It's ______ that there is more crime in cities, but there are also more police.
parts.explain: «It's true that ..., but ...» — qisman qo'shilish.

parts.q: Exam answer: The common ______ in the photos is family life. Both photos show parents and children.
parts.phrase: The common theme in the photos is ...
parts.explain: «The common theme in the photos is ...» — umumiy mavzu.

parts.q: Exam answer: In the first photo the family is eating at home, ______ in the second photo they are in a restaurant.
parts.phrase: In the first photo ..., but in the second photo ...
parts.explain: Ikki gapni farq bilan bog'lash — «but».

parts.q:
Examiner: Look at the photos.
Akmal: In ______ to the first photo, the second photo is very quiet.
parts.phrase: In contrast to the first photo, the second photo ...
parts.explain: «In contrast to ...» — «...dan farqli o'laroq». Bo'shliqqa «contrast» so'zi kerak.

parts.q:
Examiner: What's different?
Nilufar: In the first photo the people are happy, ______ in the second photo they look sad.
parts.phrase: In the first photo ..., but in the second photo ...
parts.explain: «In the first photo ..., but in the second photo ...» — farqni oddiy «but» bilan bog'laymiz.

parts.q:
Examiner: Is there anything the same?
Odil: You can ______ young people in both photos.
parts.phrase: You can see ... in both photos.
parts.explain: «You can see ... in both photos.» — «Ikkala rasmda ham ...ni ko'rish mumkin».

parts.q:
Examiner: Tell me about the photos.
Gulnora: The common theme ______ the photos is travelling.
parts.phrase: The common theme in the photos is ...
parts.explain: «The common theme in the photos is ...» — rasmlar «ichida», shuning uchun «in».

parts.q:
Lola: What do you think about the new school rules?
Malika: ______ my opinion, they are fair.
parts.explain: «In my opinion, ...» — har doim «in» predlogi bilan.

parts.q:
Diyor: Is your city getting better?
Jamshid: It seems to ______ that it's getting cleaner.
parts.explain: «It seems to me that ...» — «menga tuyuladi»; bo'shliqqa «me».

parts.q:
Sevara: Do you like the new café?
Barno: To be ______, the food is not very good.
parts.explain: «To be honest, ...» — «Rostini aytsam». Bo'shliq — «honest».

parts.q:
Teacher: Why do people move to cities?
Rustam: As I ______ it, they want better jobs.
parts.explain: «As I see it, ...» — «Men ko'rishimcha». Fe'l — «see».

parts.q:
Emma: Zoos are cruel.
Aziza: I ______ with Emma that animals need more space.
parts.explain: Gapda qo'shilish ma'nosi bor (animals need more space) — «I agree with Emma that ...».

parts.q:
Ben: Reading is boring.
Madina: I ______ with Ben. Books can be really exciting!
parts.explain: Keyingi gap qarshi fikr bildiradi — «I disagree with Ben».

parts.q:
Kevin: Football is the best sport.
Islom: It's ______ that it's popular, but I prefer tennis.
parts.explain: «It's true that ..., but ...» — qisman qo'shilish.

parts.q:
Teacher: Will robots do all our jobs?
Farrux: I don't ______ that robots will do all jobs. People are still important.
parts.explain: «I don't believe / don't think that ...» — «...ga ishonmayman / menimcha ... emas». Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.

parts.q:
Examiner: Compare the photos.
Ziyoda: The first photo ______ a family at home, whereas the second photo shows friends in a park.
parts.phrase: The first photo shows ..., whereas the second photo shows ...
parts.explain: «The first photo shows ...» — birlikda, shuning uchun «shows» (-s bilan).

parts.q:
Examiner: Is there anything the same?
Doniyor: In ______ photos there are animals.
parts.explain: «In both photos there are ...».

parts.q:
Teacher: What's your opinion about homework?
Sabina: I ______ that homework is useful, but we have too much.
parts.explain: «I think that ...» — fikr bildirish.

topics.name: Expressing opinions
topics.summary: O'z fikringizni aytayotganda gapni shu iboralardan boshlang — gapingiz yumshoq va tabiiy eshitiladi.

usage.text: I think / don't think that ... — «Menimcha ... / Menimcha ... emas». Eng oddiy, har joyda ishlatiladi.

example.en: I don't think that homework is useless.
example.uz: Menimcha, uy vazifasi foydasiz emas.

usage.text: In my opinion, ... — «Mening fikrimcha, ...». Gap boshida, keyin vergul.

example.en: In my opinion, teenagers spend too much time online.
example.uz: Mening fikrimcha, o'smirlar internetda juda ko'p vaqt o'tkazadi.

usage.text: I believe / don't believe that ... — «...ga ishonaman / ishonmayman». Fikringizga qattiq ishonganda.

example.en: I believe that sport makes people happier.
example.uz: Sport odamlarni baxtliroq qilishiga ishonaman.

usage.text: It seems to me that ... — «Menga shunday tuyuladiki, ...». Ehtiyotkorona fikr.

example.en: It seems to me that the city is getting busier.
example.uz: Menga shahar gavjumlashib borayotgandek tuyuladi.

usage.text: To be honest, ... — «Rostini aytsam, ...». Ochiq, ba'zan kutilmagan fikr oldidan.

example.en: To be honest, I didn't like the film.
example.uz: Rostini aytsam, film menga yoqmadi.

usage.text: As I see it, ... — «Men qanday ko'rsam, ...». O'z nuqtai nazaringizni ta'kidlaydi.

example.en: As I see it, the problem is money.
example.uz: Men ko'rishimcha, muammo — pul.

usage.text: I imagine that ... — «Tasavvur qilishimcha, ...». Aniq bilmaganda taxmin.

example.en: I imagine that life was harder 100 years ago.
example.uz: Tasavvurimcha, 100 yil oldin hayot qiyinroq bo'lgan.

structure.formula: I think / I believe / I imagine + that + gap

example.en: I think that cars are too expensive.
example.uz: Menimcha, mashinalar juda qimmat.

structure.formula: I don't think / I don't believe + that + ijobiy gap

example.en: I don't think that it's a good idea.
example.uz: Menimcha, bu yaxshi fikr emas.

structure.formula: In my opinion, / To be honest, / As I see it, + gap

example.en: To be honest, I'm bored.
example.uz: Rostini aytsam, zerikdim.

topics.tip: Inglizlar «I think it isn't ...» emas, «I don't think it is ...» deyishadi — inkorni «think»ga qo'ying.

topics.name: Agreeing and disagreeing
topics.summary: Birovning fikriga qo'shilganda yoki qarshi chiqqanda, sababini ham aytib, shu iboralarni ishlatasiz.

usage.text: I agree / disagree with (Emma) that ... — «(Emma)ning ... degan fikriga qo'shilaman / qo'shilmayman». Odamdan keyin «with».

example.en: I agree with Emma that the test was hard.
example.uz: Testning qiyin bo'lgani haqida Emmaga qo'shilaman.

usage.text: (Tom) is right / wrong to say that ... because ... — «(Tom) ... deb to'g'ri / noto'g'ri aytyapti, chunki ...».

example.en: Tom is right to say that buses are slow because there is a lot of traffic.
example.uz: Tom avtobuslar sekin deb to'g'ri aytyapti, chunki tirbandlik ko'p.

usage.text: It's true that ... — «To'g'ri, ...». Qisman qo'shilish, ko'pincha keyin «but».

example.en: It's true that phones are useful, but they are also distracting.
example.uz: Telefonlar foydali, to'g'ri, lekin chalg'itadi ham.

structure.formula: I agree with + odam + that + gap

example.en: I agree with you that it's expensive.
example.uz: Qimmat degan fikringizga qo'shilaman.

structure.formula: I disagree with + odam + that + gap

example.en: I disagree with Sam that the film was boring.
example.uz: Film zerikarli bo'lgan degan fikrda Semga qo'shilmayman.

structure.formula: Odam + is right / wrong + to say that ... because ...

example.en: Ali is wrong to say that it's easy because ...
example.uz: Ali buni oson deb noto'g'ri aytyapti, chunki ...

topics.tip: «I am agree» deb bo'lmaydi! «agree» — fe'l: «I agree», «I don't agree».

topics.name: Comparing photos: similarities
topics.summary: Ikki rasmni solishtirganda avval ulardagi umumiy narsani aytasiz.

usage.text: The common theme in the photos is ... — «Rasmlardagi umumiy mavzu — ...». Javobni shu bilan boshlash qulay.

example.en: The common theme in the photos is free time.
example.uz: Rasmlardagi umumiy mavzu — bo'sh vaqt.

usage.text: You can see ... in both photos. — «Ikkala rasmda ham ...ni ko'rish mumkin».

example.en: You can see young people in both photos.
example.uz: Ikkala rasmda ham yoshlarni ko'rish mumkin.

usage.text: Both photos show ... — «Ikkala rasm ham ...ni ko'rsatadi». «Both» dan keyin ko'plik (photos) va «show» (-s siz).

example.en: Both photos show people eating.
example.uz: Ikkala rasm ham ovqatlanayotgan odamlarni ko'rsatadi.

usage.text: In both photos there are ... — «Ikkala rasmda ham ... bor». Keyin ko'plikdagi ot.

example.en: In both photos there are trees.
example.uz: Ikkala rasmda ham daraxtlar bor.

example.en: Both photos show a family.
example.uz: Ikkala rasm ham oilani ko'rsatadi.

structure.formula: In both photos there are + ko'plik ot

example.en: In both photos there are cars.
example.uz: Ikkala rasmda ham mashinalar bor.

topics.tip: «Both photos shows» — xato. «Both» ko'plik, shuning uchun «show».

topics.name: Comparing photos: differences
topics.summary: O'xshashlikdan keyin rasmlar orasidagi farqni aytasiz.

usage.text: The first photo shows ..., whereas the second photo shows ... — «Birinchi rasmda ..., ikkinchisida esa ...».

example.en: The first photo shows a city, whereas the second photo shows a village.
example.uz: Birinchi rasmda shahar, ikkinchisida esa qishloq.

usage.text: In the first photo ..., but in the second photo ... — oddiyroq variant «but» bilan.

example.en: In the first photo it's sunny, but in the second photo it's raining.
example.uz: Birinchi rasmda quyoshli, ammo ikkinchisida yomg'ir yog'yapti.

usage.text: One obvious difference is (that) ... — «Eng aniq farqlardan biri — ...».

example.en: One obvious difference is that the first photo is indoors.
example.uz: Eng aniq farq — birinchi rasm bino ichida.

usage.text: Unlike the first photo, the second photo shows ... — «Birinchi rasmdan farqli ravishda ...».

example.en: Unlike the first photo, the second photo shows a big crowd.
example.uz: Birinchi rasmdan farqli ravishda ikkinchisida katta olomon bor.

usage.text: In contrast to the first photo, the second photo ... — «Birinchi rasmdan farqli o'laroq ...». «contrast» dan keyin «to».

example.en: In contrast to the first photo, the second photo is very quiet.
example.uz: Birinchi rasmdan farqli o'laroq ikkinchisi juda sokin.

structure.formula: The first photo shows ..., whereas the second photo shows ...

example.en: The first photo shows a boy, whereas the second photo shows a girl.
example.uz: Birinchi rasmda bola, ikkinchisida esa qiz.

structure.formula: Unlike / In contrast to + the first photo, the second photo ...

example.en: Unlike the first photo, the second one is dark.
example.uz: Birinchisidan farqli, ikkinchisi qorong'i.

example.en: One obvious difference is the weather.
example.uz: Aniq farq — ob-havo.

topics.tip: «In contrast with» emas, kitobdagi ibora — «In contrast to». «Unlike» dan keyin predlog kerak emas.

mistakes.wrong: I think it isn't a good idea.
mistakes.right: I don't think it's a good idea.

mistakes.wrong: In my opinion, I think that ...
mistakes.why: Ikki ibora bir xil ma'noni beradi — bittasini ishlating.
«Unlike» dan keyin «to» kelmaydi; «to» faqat «in contrast to» da.
